commands.output:
User commands manage WordPress users from the terminal.

Available commands:
• wp user list                          - List all users
• wp user create <login> <email>        - Create a user
• wp user update <id>                   - Update user data or role
• wp user delete <id>                   - Delete a user
• wp user get <id>                      - Get user details
• wp user add-role <id> <role>          - Add a role
• wp user set-role <id> <role>          - Set role (replaces existing)
• wp user remove-role <id> <role>       - Remove a role
• wp user reset-password <login>        - Send password reset email
• wp user import-csv <file>             - Bulk import from CSV
• wp user meta get/set/delete           - Manage user meta

Anchors:
→ 4wp.dev/wp-cli/users/#wp-user-list
→ 4wp.dev/wp-cli/users/#wp-user-create
→ 4wp.dev/wp-cli/users/#wp-user-import-csv
→ 4wp.dev/wp-cli/users/#wp-user-meta-get--set--delete
commands.tip: Use wp user list --role=administrator to audit admin accounts before a security review.
